full_judgment:
2. The background leading to the Rule, in short, is that the respondent No.2 Uttara Bank as plaintiff filed Title Suit which resulted in final decree and the decree was put into execution in Execution Case No. 133 of 2002 by the decree holder Bank. In that Execution Case on different dates upon application of the decree holder bank the order of warrant of arrest against the petitioner was issued. Challenging all those orders the petitioner has obtained the Rule. 

 4. Mr Hironmoy Haider, the learned counsel for the respondent-bank, on the other hand, by filing affidavit-in-opposition submits that the respondent bank has filed the Artha Rin Suit No.46 of2001 dated 4-6-2001 in the Sub-ordinate Judge and the Artha Rin Adalat, Khulna against the petitioner for realization of Taka 3,66,960 and that has been decreed on 25-11-2001. The Respondent bank has filed Execution Case No. 133 of 2002 on 3-11-2002 in the joint District Judge, Artha Rin Adalat, Khulna for recovery of Taka 3.66,960 along with cost of the suit and 18% interest till recovery of the amount. The respondent has taken steps for attachment of the schedule property on 5-5-2003 and that attachment notice was returned on 12-8-2003 by the process server stating that ক্রোকের পরোয়ানা শাস্তি ভঙ্গের আশংকায় নাজার অনে ফেরত আসিয়াছে And thereafter the respondent bank has filed an application to break the lock to attach the mortgaged property which has been allowed by the Court by ordering the police force to do the same for the attachment. Subsequently on different dates the bank has taken various steps to break the lock and has paid required amount to the police but attachment notice was returned un-served and finally the Court vide their order No. 19 dated 8-5-2005 mentioned that দায়িকের ঘরে ক্রোকযোগ্য মালামাল না থাকায় নিশানদেহী করা গেল না মর্মে রিপোর্ট অনে ক্রোকী পরোয়ানা না জারী অনে ফেরত আসিয়াছে।
